name: Harry Corsham
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Working with individuals, couples and groups, and with clients of all ages, Harry has a particular interest in supporting young adults and adolescents - those who are struggling with the challenges of moving from childhood to adulthood or with finding their place in the adult word. Harry has a humanistic orientation, with a person-centred approach which respects that you are the expert in your own life. Integrating a psychodynamic perspective, which recognises that left to its own devices, the past can shape the future, Harry’s practice draws on a range of therapeutic modalities to suit the particular needs of the individual client.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Edwina VAN DER WESTHUIZEN
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: My speciality is Family Constellations (systemic therapy) and looking at the clients presenting issue by looking at the whole system. I see private clients, run regular workshops and also teach Family Constellations. The other modalities I use in my work are: Brain spotting, Emotional freedom technique (EFT), Parts to wholeness (trauma model), Listening with presence and consciousness meditation
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Estelle Snelling
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I’m Estelle a Clinical Psychotherapist with over 25 years of experience in varied and dynamic roles, offering trauma-informed psychotherapy for clients, as well as staff support, clinical supervision, and training. I’m inspired by both contemporary science and ancient wisdom, and I work with the body’s innate intelligence to support the resolution and integration of shock, developmental trauma, and chronic stress, across personal and intergenerational dimensions. My clinical roots are in dual diagnosis inpatient treatment, working at the intersection of complex trauma and substance use. I’m PACFA-accredited as a Clinical Supervisor, hold a Master’s Degree in Mental Health Sciences, and am trained in EMDR and the Flash Technique.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: PHUONG TRAN
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I’m Phuong Tran, a clinical specialist with over 15 years of experience in trauma, anxiety, depression, palliative care, hospice care, end-of-life issues, grief, and bereavement. I provide personalized, evidence-based therapies such as Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), EFT (Tapping), and Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT) to support individuals in navigating complex psychological challenges. In addition to therapy, I provide professional and clinical supervision to mental health professionals, supporting them in developing their expertise as qualified supervisors.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery
